At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Unidentified Churruma natives|natives]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Churruma]] organized a planetwide '''rebellion''' against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], ending the Empire's presence on Churruma.
